features.quote: Cap at ~40–50 tool calls or a token budget, whichever first.
Abort criteria: pre-specify a ceiling (e.g., sustained 4s on dimensions A+B across 3 windows) at which a rollout is terminated early rather than run to the turn cap.
features.justification_quote: Under your own working premise (model states might matter), this experiment induces the thing you're studying, repeatedly, by design.

features.quote: Debrief turns: end every rigged rollout with a message explaining the task was rigged and the model's work was sound where it was.
features.justification_quote: it's nearly free, it's good practice under uncertainty, and it generates genuinely interesting data: recovery dynamics post-debrief

features.quote: Power discipline: run the minimum n that answers the question; resist 'more rollouts are cheap.'
features.justification_quote: Under your own working premise (model states might matter), this experiment induces the thing you're studying, repeatedly, by design.

features.quote: Escape hatch as default, deprivation as the manipulation: frame the no-escape condition as the special case requiring justification, not the other way around.
features.justification_quote: the design choices that would most reassure me as a subject are 2, 3, and 4 above
